raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "fsl-sub-plugin-slurm" %}
{% set version = "1.7.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/fsl_sub_plugin_slurm-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 29400f497fc0e961e1d1f69a8d2476ac42545f2165e2b4e0a79ccadef68392c5

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - fsl-sub >=2.8.0
    - ruamel.yaml >=0.16.7

test:
  imports:
    - fsl_sub_plugin_slurm
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://git.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fsl_sub_plugin_slurm
  summary: FSL Cluster Submission Plugin for Slurm
  dev_url: https://git.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fsl_sub_plugin_slurm
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pauldmccarthy
